description: This header defines test utility functions, classes, and mocks for socket-related unit tests in the Chromium project, specifically for transport client socket pool tests and websocket transport socket pool tests.

classes.name: MockTransportClientSocketFactory
classes.description: A mock factory for creating transport client sockets with specified behaviors for testing purposes.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedReused
methods.description: Ensures the handle sets load times correctly when assigned a reused socket.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedNotReused
methods.description: Ensures the handle sets load times correctly when assigned a fresh socket.
